name: Haus Tanun
beschreibung: The Gasthof Haus Tanun is located in St. Anton am Arlberg, Tirol. The rooms are functionally furnished and have a private bathroom and satellite TV. A breakfast buffet is offered daily. The restaurant at the property serves Tyrolean and Austrian cuisine. The village center of St. Anton and the valley station of the gondola lift are reachable within a few minutes' walk. In winter, guests therefore have direct access to the slopes of the Ski Arlberg area. In summer, the location is ideal as a starting point for hikes and tours. A sauna area is available after an active day.
